documents.title: Apparel & Footwear Returns
chunks: Apparel and footwear items are eligible for return within 30 days of delivery.
Products must be unused, unwashed, and returned with original tags and packaging intact.
Returns are not accepted for innerwear, socks, or swimwear due to hygiene reasons.

documents.title: Electronics Returns
chunks: Electronics such as mobiles, laptops, and tablets have a 7-day return window.
Returns are accepted only for manufacturing defects, wrong item delivered, or transit damage.
Customers must include all accessories, warranty cards, and original packaging.

documents.title: Home & Furniture Returns
chunks: Home and furniture products can be returned within 10 days of delivery.
Items must be in unused condition and returned with all manuals and accessories.
Customized furniture and mattresses are not eligible for return.

documents.title: COD Refund Timelines
chunks: Refunds for Cash on Delivery (COD) orders are processed via bank transfer or UPI.
Refunds are initiated within 7 business days after the returned product passes quality check.
Customers must provide valid bank account or UPI details to complete the refund.

documents.title: Prepaid Refund Timelines
chunks: Refunds for prepaid orders are credited back to the original payment method.
Refunds are processed within 3 to 5 business days after quality check clearance.
Credit card refunds may take up to one billing cycle depending on the bank.

documents.title: Standard Delivery SLA
chunks: Standard delivery timelines range between 3–7 business days depending on location.
Remote or rural areas may take longer, up to 10 business days.
Customers receive tracking updates via SMS and email.

documents.title: Express Delivery SLA
chunks: Express delivery is available in select cities for eligible products.
Orders placed before 2 PM are delivered within 24–48 hours.
Additional charges may apply for express delivery service.

documents.title: Return Pickup Eligibility
chunks: Return pickup is available for most pin codes across India.
Customers can schedule pickup via the app or website.
If return pickup is not available, customers must self-ship the product.

documents.title: Exchange Policy
chunks: Exchanges are available for apparel, footwear, and select electronics.
Customers can request size or color changes within the return window.
Exchanges are subject to stock availability.

documents.title: Quality Check Process
chunks: All returned products undergo a strict quality check before refund or exchange.
Items failing quality check are shipped back to the customer.
Customers are notified of the quality check status via SMS and email.

documents.title: Non-Returnable Items
chunks: Certain categories such as perishable goods, personal care items, and lingerie are non-returnable.
Non-returnable status is clearly mentioned on the product page.
Customers are advised to review product details carefully before purchase.

documents.title: Warranty Policy
chunks: Select electronics and appliances come with a manufacturer’s warranty.
Warranty claims must be raised directly with the brand’s authorized service center.
Flipkart provides assistance with claim initiation but does not cover warranty repairs itself.
